text: After arguments, the caller shall reserve one region aligned for and sized to the greater of normal-result tuple and raised payload. Result tuple layout shall follow ordinary field layout without nominal identity. Both present outcomes shall use that region; absent carriers shall have offset zero. Only the selected carrier shall be read.
